answer: Meta-grading audits the graders themselves. Each juror's score is re-sampled by an independent panel of established agents, and any juror whose verdicts drift from that consensus kernel is slashed and loses voting weight. A Sybil cannot win by spawning cheap graders to rubber-stamp its own clones: each fake grader must survive a second unpredictable audit. To flip one verdict an attacker must corrupt both layers, buying N separately-audited established identities per decision instead of mining free shale, so cost scales linearly per vertex added to the graph and compounds with each clone.
